text:
I'm so glad I found this clinic.
At first, I was really worried about my child's blurry vision. My vision was uneven and quite different in both eyes. I received advice from the optometrist and the optician. The nurses at the counter were also very friendly and made me feel very comfortable. It's not far from my house, and there's parking in front of the clinic. The glasses shop has a good selection of frames and the prices aren't too high. The doctor also recommended lenses that fit my budget and needs. I highly recommend it. You won't regret it. Thank you, doctor, for taking care of me. ♥️

text: This optical shop is staffed by an optometrist who does thorough and careful eye exams. The staff are polite, patient, and provide excellent advice on different lens types and frames. Seniors can get their glasses checked and eye exams done here as there's an ophthalmology clinic right next door.😃
